text:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — finance found a token-count discrepancy for invoices covering 2026-03-01 → 2026-03-05. Roughly ~27k tokens undercounted across a small cohort. Suspect delayed ingestion from the kinesis consumer restart.

Samir Patel: Thanks. Do we have a quick list of affected orgs or a diagnostic query?

metering-bot: alert: delayed-ingest detected. backlog=32h, source=kinesis, partition=shard-12 (auto-detected at 2026-03-03T13:40Z)

Rachel Gomez: Looks familiar — saw a similar pattern last month when a consumer crashed and auto-replay missed a window.

Tony Li: I'll own the remediation runbook. Proposed steps: 1) enumerate affected orgs 2) re-run replay for the missing window 3) run ledger backfill 4) prepare invoice corrections/credits + legal signoff 5) notify customers. ETA: EOD Fri for items 1–3, full closure by next Mon if no surprises.

Lina Park: I'll handle the customer comms and coordinate with billing/legal. Need a clear list of credits per org and a sample customer note.

Maya Chen: Please call out owners and expected PRs/jobs. Also we need an item in the postmortem to capture recurring pattern and detection tuning.

Samir Patel: Quick diagnostic SQL I ran:
```sql
SELECT org_id, SUM(tokens_expected) AS expected, SUM(tokens_ingested) AS ingested, (SUM(tokens_expected)-SUM(tokens_ingested)) AS gap
FROM token_ingest_summary
WHERE day BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-05'
GROUP BY org_id
HAVING gap > 0
ORDER BY gap DESC;
```

Rachel Gomez: Sample results from that query (sanitized): org-981 gap=12400, org-114 gap=9800, org-203 gap=4600. That sums to ~26.8k tokens.

Tony Li: Concrete action list (owners + ETA):
- [x] Root cause triage: confirmed consumer restart + missed replay window (Tony, done)
- [ ] Re-run kinesis replay for shard-12 (Samir) — target: 2026-03-04T1800Z
- [ ] Ledger backfill job id= TBD (Samir) — target: after replay completes + verification
- [ ] Draft customer credit amounts & invoice reissues (Lina + Maya) — draft by 2026-03-05
- [ ] Legal + billing signoff (Rachel) — signoff by 2026-03-05 EOD
- [ ] Postmortem writeup with recurrence mitigations (Tony) — draft by 2026-03-08

Samir Patel: Replayer command I'm going to run (dry-run first):
```bash
./kinesis-replay --shard shard-12 --from 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z --to 2026-03-06T00:00:00Z --batch-size 5000 --dry-run
```
Logs show consumer restart at 2026-03-02T11:12Z and a subsequent sticky checkpoint that skipped ~5k events.

Maya Chen: Once Samir has the replay job id and a verification sample (org ids + before/after counts), please drop them here. I need that to authorize the invoice reissue in the billing queue.

billing-bot: INFO: invoice-reissue queued for 3 accounts pending approval (job queued id=inv-reissue-6371)

Lina Park: I'll prepare a short customer note template and a credit table. Draft snippet: "We detected a delayed usage ingestion that underreported your usage for Mar 1–5. We've corrected the ledger and issued a credit of X tokens (or $Y). Apologies for the confusion. Reach out to billing@redwood.com if you have questions." Feedback welcome.

Rachel Gomez: Legal: prefer 'apologize for the inconvenience' and include a short explanation of the remediation steps. Also keep credits expressed in currency for invoices.

Tony Li: Noted. I'll own the postmortem and add recurrence mitigations: improve consumer restart alerts (lower threshold), add replay dry-run smoke tests, and add a periodic ledger parity check job.

Samir Patel: Starting dry-run now — will post the run id + sample verification in ~30m.

Maya Chen: Thanks — please also tag affected CSMs so they can prep one-off outreach if needed. @Lina can you own CSM list?

Lina Park: Yes, will loop in CSMs once I have the final org list.

Tony Li: I'll open an internal tracking ticket in our remediation board and link it here when created.

Samir Patel: dry-run output snippet (sanitized):
```
DRY_RUN OK: events_to_replay=27340, expected_gaps=26800, projected_duration=18m
```

Samir Patel: Starting real replay now. job-id=kinesis-replay-9210. Will monitor and post ledger job id after verification.

billing-bot: NOTE: invoice reissue job inv-reissue-6371 paused until ledger-backfill job completes.

Maya Chen: Putting this into finance remediation tracker. Once replay + backfill are done, we'll reconcile expected credits vs ledger applied, then unpause reissue.

Tony Li: Postmortem owner: Tony Li. Remediation doc checklist I will include: timeline, root cause, detection gap, step-by-step replay/backfill commands, customer comms templates, and action owners for 3 recurrence mitigations.

Rachel Gomez: One more ask — add a monitoring metric to detect growing 'replay backlog' over 6h and create an alert channel that pages on-call SRE + responsible owner.

Maya Chen: Agreed. Thanks everyone. Keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: Update: replay finished ok, ledger backfill scheduled job-id=ledger-backfill-5502, verification sample posted to internal drive (link: https://redwood.internal/drive/repairs/ledger-backfill-5502).

Lina Park: Draft customer note uploaded to the billing docs folder; will send to Rachel for legal signoff and then to CSMs.

Tony Li: Created postmortem draft: https://redwood.internal/pm/1947654321-postmortem-token-ingest. Will add timelines and mitigation owners tomorrow.

Maya Chen: Closing loop after billing confirms invoice reissue run. Please ping when inv-reissue-6371 resumes.

billing-bot: INFO: invoice-reissue inv-reissue-6371 resumed and completed for 3 accounts. credits_applied=true.

Maya Chen: Confirmed with billing. Marking this thread as resolved for finance follow-ups; Tony/Rachel/Samir/Lina will update the postmortem and remediation board with final closure items.

Tony Li: Will post closure note + final checklist items by 2026-03-08.

Maya Chen: Thanks all.
